headline: Gallantt Ispat submits AGM scrutinizer report
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Gallantt Ispat Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a standard corporate compliance filing following the conclusion of the shareholder meeting. Indian retail investors track these procedural filings to ensure corporate governance norms are met, though it has no direct financial impact on share price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Gallantt Ispat announces AGM voting outcomes
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Gallantt Ispat Limited has submitted the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. These filings communicate formal shareholder approval on routine corporate matters. For an Indian retail investor, such disclosures are standard compliance updates rather than valuation-moving catalysts.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on stock price
